heading_path: Design and Theatre Combined Major Credit Requirement

entries.text: Complete 86 semester hours in the major.

college: College of Arts, Media and Design
overview_text: The combined major in design and theatre integrates a knowledge of the art of theatre with the practice of understanding humans, their surrounding contexts and systems, and designing alternative futures. Students participate in both classroom and experiential learning in areas of acting, directing, playwriting, with a specific emphasis on theatrical design practices. Students choose a design option in experience design, graphic design, information design, or interaction design to inform their understanding of performance and theatrical experience.
